items.title: US charges Cuba's Raúl Castro with murder over 1996 downing of two planes
items.description: Cuba's current president says the charges against Castro - including conspiracy to kill US nationals and destruction of aircraft - are a "political manoeuvre".

items.title: Rosenberg: Putin enjoys Xi's Chinese welcome but heads home without pipeline deal
items.description: Russia and China showed they were shoulder-to-shoulder on the world stage, but it became clear there are limits, says the BBC's Russia Editor.

items.title: Sierra Leone becomes latest African country to receive deportees from US
items.description: Nine deportees arrive from the US as part of Donald Trump's crackdown on illegal immigration.

items.title: Far-right Israeli minister condemned for taunting handcuffed Gaza flotilla activists
items.description: France and Italy are among the countries that have criticised a video showing Itamar Ben-Gvir taunting dozens of activists detained at an Israeli port.

items.title: Ebola vaccine could take nine months as death toll rises further, WHO warns
items.description: In its latest update, the World Health Organization says there have now been 139 suspected deaths and 600 cases.

items.title: Murder or accident? Mystery of Mango tycoon's hiking death after son's arrest
items.description: Isak Andic's son Jonathan denies involvement in the fatal fall of his father, who founded one of Europe's biggest clothing empires.

items.title: Austrian ex-intelligence officer found guilty of Russia spying charges
items.description: The spy scandal has revived fears that Austria remains a hotbed of Russian espionage activity.

items.title: US military jets and drones tracked near Cuba as tensions rise
items.description: Tracking data shows several flights by US Navy reconnaissance jets and drones during the last week.

items.title: Whale to be removed from Danish island after failed German rescue
items.description: Danish officials will conduct a post mortem examination on the whale, which was released into the sea from a barge more than two weeks ago.

items.title: Barney Frank: One of the first openly gay US congressmen dies aged 86
items.description: After a decades-long career in Congress, he spent his final weeks in hospice care at his home in Maine.

items.title: Tesla Cybertruck driver arrested after driving into lake to use 'wade mode', police say
items.description: Police said the vehicle was abandoned by the driver after it took on water near the shoreline of Grapevine Lake in north Texas.

items.title: Lithuania's leaders take shelter during drone air alert
items.description: Flights were suspended and people were urged to take shelter after a suspected drone was detected near the Belarus border.
